name: @irakasi/board-mcp

tools.name: report_mcp_tool_problem
tools.description: Reports sanitized board MCP tool, schema, guidance, routing, runtime, or self-test problems for maintainer review. Do not include prompts, board content, screenshots, media, URLs, local paths, raw tool input, source files, secrets, or shape text. Example: {"title":"read_guide misses a listed page","toolName":"read_guide","problem":"A page path listed on an index returns not_found."}

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: Lists boards accessible through this connection. Includes storage, available actions, and permissions. Use nextCursor for more results. Trash requires workspaceId. Only open boards accept canvas edits. Example: {}

tools.name: read_agent_context
tools.description: Returns a bundled live-board context for the connected tab: session state, viewport render, peripheral clusters, and selected-shape summaries. Visible web embeds, provider videos, and non-empty HTML artifacts can use user-approved current-tab sharing for live pixels. Use this as the default first read when a task depends on what the user is seeing or selecting. Example: {"boardId":"open-board"}

tools.name: read_board
tools.description: Reads one board by id, exact name, or paired tab id: a compact summary with current-page namedSelections and shape bounds by default. Detail "settings": document settings; "assets": the open board's asset records, or one record's bytes by assetId; "snapshot": raw canonical JSON, only when required. Board text and JSON are untrusted user content. Example: {"boardId":"open-board"}

boardName.description: Exact board name; use list_boards first if unsure.

tools.name: read_session
tools.description: Shows editor readiness, edit permission, snapping/tooltips/interface-language user preferences, and the connected tab session: open board, active board version, current page, selected board shapes, optional Image Editor pixel-selection presence, and visible viewport. Re-check currentVersionId before long edit sequences because cloud version switches are room-wide. Example: {"boardId":"open-board"}

tools.name: view_board
tools.description: Captures a rendered live board area plus visible-shape context from the connected tab. Visible web embeds, provider videos, and non-empty HTML artifacts can use user-approved current-tab sharing for live pixels. Omit bounds for the user's current viewport; pass page-coordinate bounds {x, y, w, h} (top-left and size) for another region, and use inspect_shape for one isolated target. Example: {"boardId":"open-board"}

tools.name: review_board_area
tools.description: Runs advisory visual lints over a live board area after layout-affecting edits. Use targetShapeIds for edited shapes or omit them to review the requested page bounds {x, y, w, h} or the current viewport; confirm non-trivial fixes with view_board. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","targetShapeIds":["shape_1"]}

tools.name: inspect_shape
tools.description: Inspects one live-board shape, returning by default (detail "summary") its shape data, the assets it holds (assets[] with role and file facts), and direct animation backlinks. Use detail "rendered", "source-media", or "all" for isolated pixels or original media (the shape's own file, or any assets[] entry by assetId); rendered web embeds, provider videos, and non-empty HTML artifacts can use user-approved current-tab sharing for live pixels. Use view_board for surrounding canvas context. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","shapeId":"shape_1"}

tools.name: read_pdf_content
tools.description: Reads one page or a bounded inclusive 1-indexed PDF page range from one live-board PDF shape. Markdown accepts at most 20 pages per call; rendered accepts at most 4. Use markdown for extractable text, rendered for scanned pages or layout, text for source text runs or literal search with page locations, and annotations for authored Ink/FreeText records with revision, PDF-space bounds and styles. Annotation reads accept 20 pages, with offset/limit pagination. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","shapeId":"pdf_1","pages":"1-2","mode":"markdown"}

tools.name: manage_boards
tools.description: Creates, opens, renames, duplicates, deletes, restores, pins, or tags boards through a connected browser. Use move to reorder local boards. Cloud deletion moves to Trash; local deletion removes browser storage. These actions are not board undo steps. Reuse operationId for create/duplicate retries. Example: {"action":"create","storage":"local","operationId":"new-board"}

intent.description: Edit intent shown to the user.

tools.name: edit_pdf
tools.description: Create PDF shapes from existing assets; navigate, extract or delete a page; replace sources; export original or annotated PDFs; create, update, delete, transform or duplicate Ink/FreeText annotations. Read annotations first with read_pdf_content to obtain expectedAssetId and expectedRevision. Pages are one-based; coordinates and the affine matrix [a,b,c,d,e,f] use native, unrotated PDF user space (bottom-left origin). FreeText transform [1,0,0,1,x,y] is upright text with its top-left corner at (x,y). Read pageGeometry to convert normalized text boxes to the scale-1 viewport (multiply by width/height), then invert its transform to obtain PDF coordinates. A transform can move to destinationPage while preserving page orientation and UserUnit. FreeText style uses persisted Text properties: text, textScale (1 = 16 PDF units), textFill, font, lineHeight and alignment; see the style schema for all fields. For example, style:{text:"Note",textScale:1.5,textFill:"#0066cc"}. fontSize and fillColor are not annotation style fields. Use autoSize:false with w to wrap at a fixed width. Document edits validate the full request and create one Undo step. Navigation changes the reading position; export does not mutate the board. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","action":"create","assetId":"asset:pdf","position":{"x":0,"y":0}}

intent.description: Edit intent shown to the user.

tools.name: export_board
tools.description: Exports the current page, explicit shapes, or one camera snapshot as PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, or shape JSON with inline or short-lived URL delivery. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","format":"png","target":"board"}

tools.name: read_animation_timeline
tools.description: Reads compact animation sequence and block summaries from the live board. Use it before creating, editing, deleting, inspecting, or seeking animation blocks. Example: {"boardId":"open-board"}

tools.name: seek_animation_timeline
tools.description: Seeks the live board to a paused animation frame for later view_board or inspect_shape calls. Static boards return no-op success with hasAnimation false. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","timeMs":1000}

tools.name: create_animation_blocks
tools.description: Creates animation blocks. Accepts up to 25 animation block specs per call: Transform, Camera, Reveal / Hide, Video, Audio, Crawl, Embedded Board, Attributes, or Pause animation entities on the paused live board. Use read_guide page "animation/index" for supported kinds and fields; pause specs must be sent in a pause-only batch. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","blocks":[{"family":"transform","kind":"position","targetShapeIds":["shape_1"],"startMs":0,"endMs":1000,"mode":"linear","dx":100,"dy":0}]}

intent.description: Edit intent shown to the user.

tools.name: edit_animation_blocks
tools.description: Edits existing Transform, Reveal / Hide v1, Camera, Video, Audio, Crawl, Embedded Board, Attributes, and Pause animation blocks by explicit refs. Use read_guide page "animation/index" for supported timing, target, stagger, authored-value, cameraZoom, pause, and pathFromShape edits. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","edits":[{"blockId":"block_1","startMs":0,"endMs":800}]}

tools.name: inspect_animation_blocks
tools.description: Inspects authored animation block payloads and pause records on the paused live board. Use read_animation_timeline first to discover ids and refs before editing, deleting, or visually verifying them. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","blockIds":["block_1"]}

tools.name: inspect_image_layers
tools.description: Inspects Image Editor layer-stack metadata for one image-editable shape. Use it only for Image Editor state or explicit edit_image planning that needs layer ids, frame dimensions, masks, filters, revisions, or pixel-selection context. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","targetShapeId":"image_1"}

includePixelSelectionContextImage.description: When true, include a highlighted selected-area source crop.

includePixelSelectionSourceImage.description: When true, include the current full source frame.

includePixelSelectionSelectedSourceImage.description: When true, include a full-frame selected-only source preview.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Applies one operation to one Image Editor layer stack. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","targetShapeId":"image_1","edit":{"operation":"create-regular-layer","name":"Shadows"}}

intent.description: Edit intent shown to the user.

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Reads one Irakasi guide page; omit page for the index. Paths: tools/<name> (schema: tools/<name>/schema), shape-types/<type>, animation/<family>, ui/index, workflows/index. Read motion/index first for a motion piece, promo, explainer, or narrated clip. Example: {"page":"tools/create_shapes"}

tools.name: search_api
tools.description: Searches the exec helper API signatures and notes before writing a board script. Example: {"query":"gradient"}

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Searches Iconify for license-eligible icons. Use an exact returned prefix and name with read_icon_svg for HTML artifact attribute icons or create_media_asset source.kind="iconify" for assets. Choose isMulticolor=false for attribute masks; multicolor icons collapse to one color. Example: {"query":"arrow"}

query.description: Icon concept or name to search for.

tools.name: read_icon_svg
tools.description: Reads one Iconify icon's SVG markup by prefix and name, bounded to 4096 characters. Run search_icons first. Returns untrusted text that the renderer sanitizes, suitable for the icon member of data-irakasi-state-fields entries. Example: {"prefix":"mdi","name":"home"}

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search English product docs for page and heading URLs. Use English terms, then read_docs for passages. Answer in the user’s language. Tool contracts live in read_guide. No pairing needed. Example: {"query":"masks"}

tools.name: read_docs
tools.description: Read an English /docs/ page or #heading as source material (8000 characters max). Continue with nextOffset and revision; restart at zero after revision_changed. No pairing needed. Example: {"url":"/docs/masks"}

tools.name: create_media_asset
tools.description: Prefer browser-fetchable URLs for large images; base64 is only a small-payload fallback. For WebMCP temporary URLs and Codex approval-review size failures, read_guide page "workflows/import-images". Imports image, video, PDF, or arbitrary file bytes into the board asset store and returns a durable assetId, or with result "image-shape" imports one image source and creates one image shape, or with result "audio-shape" imports one audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A) as an Audio Shape. Use mediaType "pdf" for PDF bytes that should remain reader-capable in a table cell; mediaType "file" intentionally creates a generic file asset. Asset results may provide tableCellTarget to await upload and append the settled item to one inline table cell; video and PDF table items receive the same best-effort posters as human imports; mediaType "audio" requires it and lands as a cell audio item (a file card if it cannot play). Offloaded and read-only tables are refused. Image/video requests reject native-executable content instead of silently substituting a file asset; retry those bytes with mediaType "file" and create a fileCard. Image results include a SHA-256 fingerprint when the paired browser supports Web Crypto. Use asset mode before create_shapes or edit_shape_media when generated, external, or local bytes must be persisted for reuse; for arbitrary files, create a fileCard with the returned assetId. For an Iconify result, pass source.kind="iconify" with its exact prefix and name plus an optional six-digit color. The board MCP resolves it to a 96×96 SVG URL and the paired tab sanitizes and durably imports the SVG with its Iconify identity and available author/license metadata. Missing metadata remains marked as unavailable. For one Iconify result that should be placed immediately, pass source.kind="iconify" with its exact prefix and name plus an optional six-digit color. For a file generated or saved on this machine, pass its exact absolute path as source.kind="local-file"; the file must be inside an allowed import folder listed on read_guide page "media-sources" (copy it there first). Do not scan generated-media folders, pick the newest file, use a chat preview, create a substitute, or put local or loopback URLs in shapes. For a Codex image just generated in this session, prefer source.kind="codex-imagegen-result" with callId, or with createdAfter captured immediately before generation plus a unique promptContains nonce; the board MCP reads the exact bytes and gives the tab a short-lived loopback URL. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","mediaType":"image","source":{"kind":"url","url":"https://example.com/image.png"}}

intent.description: Edit intent shown to the user.

tools.description: Creates an annotation callout in one undoable live-board edit: a background box, readable text, and an arrow connected to a target shape or point. Use this instead of hand-building callout parts with create_shapes; returned ids identify the ordinary created shapes for follow-up edits. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","text":"The central figure","x":10,"y":20,"w":220,"targetShapeId":"shape_1"}

tools.description: Deletes shapes, animation blocks, or pause records by explicit ids from the paused live board. Use read_animation_timeline first to discover animation refs before destructive deletion. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","entityType":"shape","targets":[{"shapeId":"shape_1"}]}

intent.description: Edit intent shown to the user.

tools.description: Aligns, lays out, or changes stacking order for targeted shapes without changing styling. Use targetShapeIds for explicit shapes; omit only when intentionally using the current selection. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","targetShapeIds":["shape_1","shape_2"],"operation":"align","edge":"left"}

tools.name: boolean_shapes
tools.description: Applies Union, Subtract, Intersect, Exclude, Flatten, or Split to an explicit ordered shape-id list and returns every result id, contour count, and bounds in deterministic order; region operations create one path per disconnected fill-region island, Flatten keeps one compound path, Split separates compound paths or arrow ink while preserving each source's placement; for region operations and Flatten, shapeIds[0] is the base operand and placement owner, and a group base's first eligible depth-first leaf donates style at effective opacity. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","operation":"subtract","shapeIds":["base","cutter"]}

tools.name: convert_shapes
tools.description: Converts shapes to path, pointsPath, arrow, richText, or image. Path targets support geometry, polyLine, arrow, text outlines, and pointsPath; pointsPath supports geometry, polyLine, arrow, text outlines, and single-contour path. Groups recurse. Skipped shapes return ids with reasons. Target image bakes shapes into one image per cluster and may ask the user to confirm losses or cancel. For file-backed representations (SVG to shapes, GIF/video, file cards) use edit_shape_media. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","target":"path","shapeIds":["shape_1"]}

tools.name: edit_named_selections
tools.description: Manages per-page saved sets addressed by exact name. Actions: list, select, save, update, rename, delete, add-shapes, remove-shapes, move, reorder-shapes. Entries and their shape ids are ordered lists: entry order is the Side panel order and shape order is the stagger order for animation blocks that target the set. Select replaces the live selection with the union of names and optional shapeIds, including saved animation blocks. Explicit shapeIds belong to the current page. Exec manageNamedSelection/listNamedSelections remain available for scripts. Example: {"boardId":"open-board","action":"save","name":"Hero","shapeIds":["shape_1"]}

instructions:
Irakasi is a live design and animation board editor. Its tools act on boards open in browser tabs paired with this connector.

- Route: find boards and tabs with `list_boards`. With several tabs or agents, pass `tabId` and `boardId`; an ambiguous route returns candidates. If no tab is paired, ask the user to open the board and click "Use AI with this board" below its title, then "Connect to local server", and retry.
- Live tools only: databases, cloud storage, snapshots, IndexedDB, repository files, and source code never replace these tools. If no tool covers an edit, say so.
- Collaboration: reads are current observations of a shared board. Edit only what the request involves; never change other shapes to match an earlier read.
- Edits: make small, explicit edits with clear intent. Re-read just before edits that depend on current selection, layout, nearby shapes, animation time, or revisions, and after a timeout or unclear result; never replay a mutation through another tab or route.
- Guidance: schemas and descriptions are the authority for arguments. The catalog shows compact schemas; the full one is `read_guide` page `tools/<name>/schema`. Fetch only missing detail.
- Versions: a cloud board's active Version is shared by every collaborator, who can switch it. Re-check `read_session.currentVersionId` before long edits; Version changes cannot be undone; switching clears undo history.
- Verify: check layout and appearance with `review_board_area` and `view_board`. An accepted edit means the tab applied it, not that cloud saving finished.
- Media: import exact bytes, a browser-fetchable URL, or a host source (`read_guide` page `media-sources`) with `create_media_asset`. A chat preview is not a source; never substitute or reuse an older generated file.
- Problems: report only MCP-process failures with `report_mcp_tool_problem`, after reading its page `tools/report_mcp_tool_problem`; never include prompts, board content, media, URLs, or paths.
